LanguageData.AASBExt.Anima.SurfaceOnly: Anima trees spawn only on the main floor (0)
LanguageData.AASBExt.Anima.LimitTip: Limits natural spawns across all floors of each map. A maximum of one does not guarantee a tree. Turning the limit off removes the extra cap. Existing trees remain.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Anima.SurfaceTip: Prevents natural spawning on upper and underground floors. Works independently of the quantity limit.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Anima.Unavailable: Natural anima tree settings require Royalty and a supported generation contract.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.ReloadMap: Reload the map to refresh the projected geometry.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.VisualUnavailable: The glass projection contract is unavailable.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.RequiresConstructedRoof: Requires a clear constructed roof between adjacent above-ground floors.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.DubsSkylights: Show the lower floor through Dubs Skylights
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.VentExchange: Exchange heat through vertical ventilation grates
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.EndlessHorizon: Show the Endless Horizon landscape on above-ground floors
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.Restart: Takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.NoPair: Requires two adjacent above-ground floors. Place the grate on the upper floor.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.NaturalRoof: Natural rock roofing blocks the grate.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.BlockedBelow: Clear the tile directly below the grate.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.BlockedAbove: A building covers the upper opening.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.Disabled: Grate heat exchange is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.EncloseAbove: Enclose and roof the upper room to exchange heat.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Vent.EncloseBelow: Enclose and roof the lower room to exchange heat.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Diagnostics.Failed: Could not save the diagnostic report. Check access to the RimWorld user data folder.
LanguageData.AASBExt.ColumnPipe.Enable: Reserve riser cells for their built-in pipes
LanguageData.AASBExt.ColumnPipe.Tip: Use the riser buttons to connect each network. Existing pipes stay where they are. Turning this off allows manual placement where the original mods allow it.
LanguageData.AASBExt.ColumnPipe.Reserved: Use the vertical riser’s network buttons to connect this pipe.
LanguageData.AASBExt.ColumnPipe.Conflict: Remove {0} before connecting this network in the riser.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.SkiptechTip: Lets eligible pawns use MigCorp Skiptech doors for work and movement between floors. Turning this off restores original routing. Door power, access and animal rules come from Skiptech.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.EndlessHorizonTip: Shows the surface landscape around the main and upper floors. Turning this off restores the original Horizon behaviour after restart. The integration is experimental.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.DubsSkylightsTip: Adds support for Dubs Skylights as viewing and light-transfer openings. Disable it to stop added projection and light transfer through these skylights, then reload the map.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.GameplayLightTip: Lets light through glass reach the cells below for plant growth and other game light checks. Turning this off keeps the visual view setting independent.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.VentExchangeTip: Open grates let two enclosed rooms on adjacent above-ground floors exchange heat through a constructed roof. Turn this off to pause heat exchange in existing grates.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.MountedSkipdoors: Respect mount access rules at inter-floor Skipdoors
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.MountedSkipdoorsTip: Checks Skiptech animal and door access rules for a Giddy-up mount as well as the rider. When the mount is denied, use stairs or dismount. Disabling this restores the original rider-only check.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Settings.SilhouettesTip: Skips silhouettes whose graphics failed to initialize. Disable to restore the original renderer when the missing-graphics problem is resolved.
LanguageData.AASBExt.Diagnostics.Glass: Save glass report at camera centre
